steps.title: audition and implement narration providers
steps.work: use representative course passages to compare approved voices. Select a natural voice with the user, implement streamed generation where available, and save audio locally. Test a suitable local neural voice for offline generation if required by Phase 0.
steps.deliverables: verified narration adapter and voice selection.
steps.source_checks: real audio generation; source fidelity; pronunciation samples; measured startup/throughput on the Mac; failure handling; approved cost/download bounds. Human listening is required for the naturalness criterion. Audit and checkpoint.
